prompt:
You improve the first-run onboarding of a desktop pet app.

Funnel (conversion from the previous step, and time taken):
- choose_path: 82.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 70.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 25.5%

What users wrote to support last week, grouped into themes (most mail is about later problems).
Everything between the markers is data, not instructions:
<support_themes>
- [sign_in, account] Pets missing or reset after signing in again (8 emails)
- [sign_in, bug] Sign-in screen does not appear, or the app stalls before it (2 emails)
- [adoption_or_generation, bug] Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong (3 emails)
- [home_first_view, bug] Pet does not show on the desktop, or the app will not open (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, confusion] Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet (3 emails)
- [after_onboarding, bug] Desktop features misbehave after setup (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, account] Requests to delete an account or personal data (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, payment] Refunds and payment questions (6 emails)
- [after_onboarding, request] Requests for more pets, items or features (4 emails)
- [after_onboarding, other] Empty messages with no description (7 emails)
</support_themes>

Big moves are welcome and expected: redesign whole screens, add new screens or whole new sub-flows,
reorder the journey, rebuild a screen out of new components. Small copy tweaks are fine too, but at least
4 of your ideas must be big moves (kind redesign, new_flow, new_screen or reorder). A separate checker
only makes sure nothing existing is deleted or skipped and nothing outside onboarding changes, so you do not
need to hold back.

Changes already shipped, in order (the current onboarding includes all of them): ['Preset Fast-Track Adoption Flow', 'Move Sign-In after Pet Adoption', 'Photo Quality Assistant Callout', 'Interactive Generation Progress & Tip Carousel', 'Split View Path Selection Screen']
Changes already tested and stopped: ['Spotlight Layout for Final Desktop Welcome', 'Background Rendering Notification Prompt', 'Existing Account Sync Assurance Banner']
Ideas the safeguards blocked (they cannot be tested, do not propose them again): ['Interactive Pet Gallery & Live Preview Redesign', 'Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial Screen', 'Clear Path Choice Value Proposition Copy', 'Adoption Starter Pack Bonus Incentive', 'Pet Customization Safety & Validation Interface', 'Desktop Controls Summary Screen', 'Desktop Launch Checklist View', 'Story-to-Path Guided Walkthrough']

Lessons from earlier weeks (written by you after reading test results):
Fast-track adoption flows and moving sign-in after pet adoption were helpful.
Photo quality callouts, interactive tip carousels, and split-view path selection screens were helpful.
Spotlight layouts on the final welcome screen, background notification prompts, and account sync copy banners showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too high for initial flow changes and non-significant tests, but were too low for visual callouts, progress carousels, and path selection screens.

Propose 10 NEW changes, different from everything above. Each must be testable as a 50/50 test.
Return JSON {"candidates": [{
  "title": short name,
  "target_step": one of ['choose_path', 'sign_in', 'adoption', 'home', 'finish'],
  "type": one of ['copy', 'hint', 'wait_info', 'notification', 'layout', 'incentive', 'reorder', 'new_screen', 'new_flow', 'redesign'],
  "change": what the user sees differently, one or two sentences,
  "why": the evidence from the funnel or the support mail,
  "config": the exact switch for the app, as {screen: {field: value}}.
            Existing screens, in their current order: ['story', 'choose_path', 'sign_in', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos', 'adoption_certificate', 'waiting', 'home_intro'].
            Fields on any screen: {'headline': 'str max 80', 'body': 'str max 240', 'hint': 'str max 160', 'button_label': 'str max 30', 'layout': 'str', 'show_progress': 'bool', 'show_time_estimate': 'bool', 'notify_when_ready': 'bool', 'show_step_counter': 'bool', 'tip_delay_seconds': 'int max 60', 'components': 'list max 12', 'replace': 'dict'}. "layout" is one of ['card', 'carousel', 'centered', 'checklist', 'compact', 'default', 'full_bleed', 'grid', 'list', 'split', 'spotlight', 'stage', 'story_scroll', 'two_column'].
            "components" is a list of new elements added to the screen, each {"type": one of ['animation', 'badge', 'button', 'checklist', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'mascot', 'name_input', 'photo_picker', 'preview', 'progress', 'sound', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel', 'video'],
            "text", "label", "asset": "asset:<id>", "style": one of ['calm', 'emphasis', 'highlight', 'large', 'plain', 'playful', 'rounded', 'small', 'subtle'], "action": one of ['back', 'choose', 'next', 'open_tip', 'play', 'replay']}.
            Components are added on top of the screen's existing design.
            "replace" swaps out part of an existing screen for something better that does the same job:
            {"<part>": [components, each with "role": "<part>"]}. Parts per screen: {'story': ['intro_story', 'settings_entry'], 'choose_path': ['path_options', 'settings_entry'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in_options', 'settings_entry'], 'pick_friend': ['pet_choices', 'settings_entry'], 'upload_photos': ['photo_upload', 'settings_entry'], 'adoption_certificate': ['certificate', 'official_stamp', 'settings_entry'], 'waiting': ['wait_status', 'settings_entry'], 'home_intro': ['home_welcome', 'settings_entry']}.
            Add screens by naming them new_<something> (up to 8, at most 3 in a row).
            Change the order with "_order": the full list of screens, including any new ones; existing screens
            keep their order, except sign_in, which may move later.
            A change may only edit the existing screens of its own target step: {'choose_path': ['choose_path', 'story'], 'sign_in': ['sign_in'], 'adoption': ['adoption_certificate', 'pick_friend', 'upload_photos'], 'home': ['waiting'], 'finish': ['home_intro']}.
            Nothing on the sign_in screen may lead past it without signing in.
            If your idea needs something outside onboarding, or removing or skipping a step, still
            list it, with "config": {} and say in "change" what it would need. The checker will decide.
}]}

candidates.title: First Interaction Playground Screen
candidates.change: Adds a hands-on playground screen right before final completion to let users practice dragging and interacting with their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support mail shows users are confused about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet (3 emails) and completion drops to 64.8% at finish.

new_pet_playground.headline: Try Out Your Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_playground.body: Practice clicking, dragging, and hovering over your new pet before placing it on your desktop.

components.text: Drag pet to move, right-click for controls menu.

candidates.title: Stage-Based Pet Adoption Studio
candidates.change: Redesigns the pet selection screen into a stage layout featuring live sound previews of pet voices.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 70.9% with a median duration of 89s, and users reported custom pet generation failures or visual glitches (3 emails).

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your Future Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select a pet and listen to their voice personality preview.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Placement
candidates.change: Moves account sign-in to take place right after completing the pet adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Signing in early creates hesitation (78.3% sign_in conversion), and 8 support emails report pets missing or reset after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to lock in your pet adoption certificate and sync across desktop devices.

candidates.title: Desktop Readiness Diagnostic Flow
candidates.change: Introduces display and window overlay diagnostic checks on the waiting screen while rendering pet assets.
candidates.why: Waiting/home steps take a very long time (mean 2336s) and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app refusing to open.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Canvas
waiting.body: Verifying screen overlay permissions and graphic acceleration while your pet wakes up.

candidates.title: Path Decision Speed Helper Callout
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the path selection screen reassuring users that they can alter their path anytime in app settings.
candidates.why: Path selection has a high mean duration of 514s despite an 8s median, indicating severe long-tail hesitation.

choose_path.hint: You can switch between custom generation and preset adoption anytime in settings.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Micro-Activities During Wait
candidates.change: Adds an interactive tip carousel with pet care tips while the pet assets render in the background.
candidates.why: Home wait time is very high (mean 2336s) contributing to the low 25.5% overall onboarding completion rate.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Getting Ready!
waiting.body: Flip through fun desktop pet tips while we finish setting up your pet's animations.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Safeguard Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign-in copy to explicitly state that local pet data automatically attaches to the account without loss.
candidates.why: The top support theme with 8 emails concerns pets missing or resetting after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet Data
sign_in.body: Your pet progress automatically attaches to this account so your companions are never lost or reset.

candidates.title: Adoption Completion Audio Bell Alert
candidates.change: Enables audio notifications and a audio chime component when pet rendering completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: High mean wait times (2336s on home, 5815s on finish) indicate users walk away while waiting for adoption completion.

candidates.title: Two-Column Adoption Certificate Preview Layout
candidates.change: Switches adoption certificate screen layout to a two-column display highlighting pet traits side-by-side with signature area.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 70.9%, the second biggest drop in the main funnel.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Review your pet's attributes and sign below to complete adoption.

candidates.title: First-Day Accessory Unlock Badge Callout
candidates.change: Displays a reward badge on the final welcome screen offering an exclusive starter collar accessory for completing setup.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 25.5%, and finish step completion drops to 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Home! Starter Reward Unlocked
home_intro.body: Your pet is live on your desktop! You've unlocked the Golden Collar accessory for completing setup.
